explorer.title: Explore: the roads to the station sites and the systems beside them, then the frontier
explorer.note: Fit: the starter Threshold, empty hold (rule F3). Long jumps train navigation fastest. 2026-11-21 23:36 UTC: the map holds no never-read system a list can take (ROADS END); an explorer reads its road list, then its far list oldest first (own routes), then census-roads, and helps census-worked-far only when those stand read.

reader.title: Read where the fleet works: the outpost site and its neighbours, the places our routes use, the frontier, the roads
reader.note: Fit: the starter Threshold, empty hold. 2026-11-22 23:40 UTC (orders ENT-068): the home census moved here from the list First, since a census is open to a pilot of another empire wherever its system lies; the region lists are the newborns' own (@outerrim, @nebula) and the stationed scouts'.

outerrim.title: Outer Rim scouts: their home region around Altais (P6)
outerrim.note: For scouts born Outer Rim: their empire's visit missions at Altais first (paid once each; the who-buys and proposal tests paid on their first scout runs, 2026-11-22), then the region of their capital only (orders ENT-068 P6: far only by far_ok).

nebula.title: Nebula scouts: their home region around Haven (P6)
nebula.note: For scouts born Nebula: the Haven region's docking mission first (paid 33 of 128 runs, every division; once each), then the region of their capital only (orders ENT-068 P6).
